claims.text: The FOMC decided to raise the target range for the federal funds rate to 3/4 to 1 percent.

citations.quotation: the Committee decided to raise the target range for the federal funds rate to 3/4 to 1 percent

claims.text: Neel Kashkari dissented, preferring at this meeting to maintain the existing target range for the federal funds rate.

citations.quotation: Voting against the action was Neel Kashkari, who preferred at this meeting to maintain the existing target range for the federal funds rate.

claims.text: The 2 percent figure is the Committee's symmetric inflation goal, distinct from the federal funds rate target range: the Committee monitors inflation relative to this goal, and policy aims at a sustained return to 2 percent inflation.

citations.quotation: The Committee will carefully monitor actual and expected inflation developments relative to its symmetric inflation goal.
The stance of monetary policy remains accommodative, thereby supporting some further strengthening in labor market conditions and a sustained return to 2 percent inflation.

counterarguments.text: None identified in the sources; the statement itself does not present an opposing view beyond the recorded dissent, and Kashkari's stated rationale is not included in the excerpts.

limitations: The sources are partial excerpts of the March 15, 2017 FOMC statement; Kashkari's reasons for dissenting are not included in the provided text.
The excerpts do not include the prior target range, so the size of the increase cannot be determined from the provided evidence.
